title: Another bot joins the showcase
summary:
A quiet day for the garden: one more community bot in the showcase and a README update about Quests.

REKTY AI was added to the bots category in the app catalog, Greenhouse, and README showcase, bringing the Greenhouse count to 813 community apps.

The README’s Latest News now points readers to the June 25 Quests update, covering Pollen rewards for GitHub contributions and cross-modality model usage. An older GLM-5.2 news entry was removed from the list; the model itself did not change.
